currentParagraphText: “Do you still get nervous when visiting Yggdrasil?” Jake asked as they went through a teleporter.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: “You not being nervous is the outlier here, not me,” Artemis shook her head.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Either way, time would tell. Artemis and Jake had headed straight toward the Primordial after the message was received, and it was quite evident the hunter goddess was even more nervous than the mortal C-grade. Jake was more excited than anything.
